build_questions_for_db: build questions and answers for a database by generating derivations from triples and fact templates
generate_positive_question: generate a positive question with its answer from a given question ID and candidate set
generate_negative_bool: generate a negatively sampled boolean question by mutating the object in the original hypothesis triple
generate_derivations: generate question-answer derivations for all subject-relation-object triples using configured question templates
run_make_questions_cli: run the CLI tool to process an input JSONL database file and output questions with answers and derivations
